# Certificate Maker

> Free online certificate generator: create professional award, completion, recognition and graduation certificates in your browser in 30 seconds. No design skills, no software, no signup. The first certificate is free; a one-time $9.99 unlocks all premium templates and watermark-free downloads.

## Tools

- [Certificate Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/): Generate and download a printable certificate from 26 templates (classic, victorian, gold seal, marble, and more) with customizable recipient, reason, colors and fonts.
- [Certificate QR Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/certificate-qr-maker.html): Add a scannable QR code to any certificate for verification or event check-in.
- [Invitation Card Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/invitation-card-maker.html): Design birthday, wedding and event invitation cards from 20+ templates.
- [Name Tag Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/name-tag-maker.html): Print professional name tags and badges for events and conferences.
- [Diploma Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/diploma-maker.html): Create formal academic diplomas with ornamental borders and seals.
- [Business Card Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/business-card-maker.html): Design and print business cards with modern and classic styles.
- [Flyer & Poster Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/flyer-poster-maker.html): Make flyers and posters for promotions, events and announcements.
- [Thank You Card Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/thank-you-card-maker.html): Create elegant thank-you cards for customers and staff.
- [Event Ticket Maker](https://aiharryone.github.io/certificate-maker/event-ticket-maker.html): Generate printable event tickets with QR, dates and seating.

## Pricing

- Free: one certificate with a small watermark.
- $9.99 one-time (no subscription): all premium templates, unlimited certificates, watermark-free downloads.
